194:t_1:257.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Where do you think you're going, $$アルト$$!?」

194:t_1:258.en:
$$アルト$$
「I...! I'm going to rescue those two with my own hands!」

194:t_1:264.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you doing, $$ノノ$$! Don't go off on your own!」

194:t_1:266.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What on earth is here? What did you come here for?」

194:t_1:267.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I don't know... $$ノノ$$'s feet just started moving on their own...」

194:t_1:268.en:
$$ラルク$$
「H-hey... What are you going to do?」

194:t_1:269.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm going to open this door.」

194:t_1:270.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Did you sense something on the other side?」

194:t_2:3.en: ～ $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$, Detention Facility ～

194:t_2:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
($$シェリル$$'s been singing this whole time... But me...)

194:t_2:7.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$アルト$$! You came for us!」

194:t_2:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I could hear your song through the Fold Quartz earring.」

194:t_2:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you know where $$ランカ$$ is?」

194:t_2:10.en:
$$シェリル$$
「She's right here with me, of course.」

194:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm glad you're safe... Major $$オズマ$$ and I have been worried about you this whole time.」

194:t_2:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「We're escaping right away. The $$クォーター$$ is here too.」

194:t_2:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll take the lead! $$シェリル$$, look after $$ランカ$$!」

194:t_3:3.en: ～ $$サイデリアル$$ $$ターミナル・ベース$$ ～

194:t_3:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$シモン$$. For you guys to join us.」

194:t_3:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$新世界大陸$$ had a hard time fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too. We couldn't easily get moving.」

194:t_3:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But hey, with the power of $$超銀河グレンラガン$$, couldn't you blast the Empire away in no time?」

194:t_3:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「...$$超銀河ダイグレン$$ was taken from us by them.」

194:t_3:9.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It can't land on Earth. So we left $$ダヤッカ$$, $$姫$$ $$ニア$$ and the others behind and went back to the $$新世界大陸$$ with only the Gunmen...」

194:t_3:10.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We were fighting the Empire there, but they resorted to a despicable trick.」

194:t_3:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$, was it?」

194:t_3:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah... He took the residents of the $$新世界大陸$$ hostage and demanded we hand over $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.」

194:t_3:13.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$ロシウ$$ agonized over it for a long time, too. The hostages' lives mattered, of course, but handing it over is the same as losing hope...」

194:t_3:14.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But in the end, it was $$ニア$$'s words that made $$ロシウ$$ decide to hand it over.」

194:t_3:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「She said hope can be taken back, but a life can't be brought back...」

194:t_3:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A life can't be brought back, huh...」

194:t_3:18.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Just like that, $$ダヤッカ$$, $$姫$$ $$ニア$$ and the others fell into the enemy's hands along with $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.」

194:t_3:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「So did the hostages come back?」

194:t_3:21.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「His $$スフィア$$'s power amplified the hatred sleeping in their hearts.」

194:t_3:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard... He pulled that same trick again...!」

194:t_3:25.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We've isolated them. We couldn't handle them otherwise...」

194:t_3:27.en:
$$シモン$$
「After that, $$ロシウ$$ strengthened our defenses and committed fully to a defensive war.」

194:t_3:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「It couldn't be helped if we wanted to protect everyone, but that way the fighting will never end.」

194:t_3:29.en:
$$ギミー$$
「That's why we were heading for $$ラース・バビロン$$, where the Empire's top guy is.」

194:t_3:30.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Then we heard about all of you from $$ロシウ$$ and came here to join up.」

194:t_3:31.en:
$$ギミー$$
「If we'd joined up a little sooner, we could've taken part in the operation to rescue the captured people.」

194:t_3:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... as it turned out, your presence dealt major damage even to the mind of that $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.」

194:t_3:33.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Welcome, $$シモン$$. With you guys here, it's like gaining an army of ten thousand allies.」

194:t_3:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「Same here. With everyone here, there's nothing to fear.」

194:t_3:35.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Now that this much strength has gathered, our only target is the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

194:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Speaking of new strength, where's $$ノリコ$$...?」

194:t_3:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「She's over there fighting with $$ノノ$$.」

194:t_3:38.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I told you already...! I'm with the $$トップ部隊$$, and I don't know anything about $$トップレス$$!」

194:t_3:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then why are you riding a $$バスターマシン$$!?」

194:t_3:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ is humanity's hope, and it burns my life and Big Sis's life to become a flame!」

194:t_3:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You even have a Big Sis?! How far are you going to go copying $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis!?」

194:t_3:42.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You say that, but you're just an apprentice. You have no right to say anything about $$トップレス$$.」

194:t_3:45.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She's just been calling me that on her own.」

194:t_3:46.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$... Nice to meet you.」

194:t_3:47.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$. In $c, that makes me the junior.」

194:t_3:48.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Getting all friendly with $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis without permission...! Besides, I don't like that name!」

194:t_3:50.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! The name $$ノリコ$$... doesn't it sound like $$ノノリリ$$!」
